description: Panel (b) displays a temperature (°C) vs. concentration (wt%) binary phase diagram for a DES system, showing three regions: Solid (lower-left), Liquid (upper region), and the two-phase Solid–Liquid boundary curve. Annotated points include T_melt(A), T_melt(B), T_eutectic, and the eutectic composition. The diagram illustrates the thermodynamic basis for DES formation and cannot be fully digitised without higher-resolution data.
notes: Qualitative phase diagram — key features recorded as annotations
